data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased materially during 2020: the gross claims development triangle shows a net gross strengthening of approximately GBP 84.8m across prior underwriting years (primarily 2013-2018). This movement reflects adverse reserve re-estimates / large loss development and IBNR recalibration on older years; an increase in reinsurers' recoverable partly offset the net impact, producing a net favourable movement in the technical account. The main affected classes include casualty (third party liability) and miscellaneous classes where adverse development was recorded, while accident & health, marine and property showed favourable movements on a net basis.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 8.3m (2019 favourable development: GBP 15.2m).

The increase in the net loss ratio to 62.0% (2019: 60.8%) includes the impact of COVID-19 on the 2020 results, with the additional reserves recognised in relation to potential COVID-19 losses adding 7.0% to the net claims ratio.
The impact on the net claims ratio of natural catastrophe loss reserving movements in the year is 17%, an improvement of 4% when compared to the 2019 total of 21%.
Key CAT losses in 2020 are Hurricanes Sally, Laura, Zeta and the Derecho severe weather event.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was computed from the gross claims development table (cumulative incurred triangle) on page 31 by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2013-2018. The report also shows net prior year development (favourable GBP 8.3m) in the P&L; this is net of reinsurance and differs materially from the gross triangle result because reinsurers' share of claims increased. Per-line prior year movements available in the document are reported net of reinsurance in the 'Claims incurred, net of reinsurance' table; those net amounts were used for lob_movements where gross per-line figures were not provided. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' GROSS figure was provided, so triangle method was used. RITC / Part VII activity noted elsewhere may distort comparisons in other years but does not appear to invalidate the triangle used here.
